verdicts.title: Heavy-Quark Masses from the Fermilab Method in Three-Flavor Lattice QCD
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We report on heavy quark mass calculations using Fermilab heavy quarks. verdicts.title: Form factors for $B$ to $Kll$ semileptonic decay from three-flavor lattice QCD
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the $B \to Kl^+l^-$ semileptonic decay process in three-flavor lattice QCD. We analyze several ensembles generated by the MILC collaboration at different lattice spacings and sea-quark masses. We use the asqtad improved staggered action for the light quarks and the clover action with the Fermilab interpretation for the heavy $b$ quark. verdicts.title: Karchmer-Wigderson Games for Hazard-free Computation
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
We present a Karchmer-Wigderson game to study the complexity of hazard-free formulas. This new game is both a generalization of the monotone Karchmer-Wigderson game and an analog of the classical Boolean Karchmer-Wigderson game. Therefore, it acts as a bridge between the existing monotone and general games.
